latest_release.name: OpenHuman v0.64.15
latest_release.body:
# The Installed-Build Reliability Upgrade

This release focuses on keeping installed apps rock-solid—especially when loading key modules like search and memory. Onward and upward! 🎉

## Highlights

### Modules & installed builds 🧩
A targeted hotfix improves module admission in installed builds so critical modules load correctly again—unblocking both search (`tinysearch`) and memory (`tinymemory`) where they could previously fail due to module directory permission checks.  

([#7155](https://github.com/tinyhumansai/openhuman/pull/7155)) — Thank you @senamakel!

## Contributor Credits
Thanks to @senamakel for the fix and the fast turnaround!

## Full Compare
https://github.com/tinyhumansai/openhuman/compare/v0.64.14...v0.64.15

hot_issues.title: [tiny-modules] agent: explicit dispatch context for the remaining 9 task-locals (follow-up to #7609)
Vendor modules: OpenHuman-shaped simulation, hardening, benchmark & test suites (tracker)
Benchmark OpenHuman: run Terminal-Bench, split intelligence from harness failures, and close the cache / cold-start gaps
Agent-runtime boundary gate keys violations on line number, so unrelated line shifts redden it — main is stale 6h after #6462 re-baselined, with zero change to the violation set
Make the memory queue's LLM concurrency (llm_permits) configurable
TinyJuice LLM summary blocks agent turns for 15–30s per large tool result
Renderer enters a sustained update loop (React #185) while a tool call's arguments stream: mascot and composer are bystanders
Epic: shrink modules/ to registry + wiring — move generic module hosting to tinybus, storage hosting to tinystoragedrivers, typed clients to *-client crates
